ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) field comprising approximately 85% of the visible surface, with localized high-intensity (white/light grey) regions at the distal-lateral tips comprising approximately 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity geometric blobs are isolated at the extreme lateral margins of both lobes. The left distal tip displays a branching, complex high-intensity pattern. The right distal tip displays a more consolidated high-intensity patch with internal low-intensity mottling. Sparse, point-source high-intensity pixels are distributed across the primary medial-inferior dark surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a measured interior angle of approximately 72 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 18% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the superior boundary. Medial sections exhibit high-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations (2-4 pixel height), while distal sections transition to lower-frequency, higher-amplitude macro-irregularities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Superior margins exhibit a concave sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, while the inferior margins exhibit a broad convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters are present at both the left and right terminal tips. Small-scale (<4 pixel diameter) high-intensity circular points are visible across the dark ventral surface, primarily concentrated in the lower quadrants.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible, notably several vertically oriented light streaks on the left lobe and diagonal streaks on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive focal scarring and sessile organism colonization clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
